title: Rav Huna bar Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Yalkut, Eichah, remez 1001, and reports that in Eichah Rabbah, chapter 1, on “She has become like a widow,” the statement is attributed to R' Chama bar Ukva.[^1]

notes.text: All three whole paragraphs of the selected digital Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1001 and the whole Torat Emet Eikhah Rabbah 1:1 scalar were read without finding the Huna/Chama bar Ukva attribution. These are bounded nonmatches only; they do not establish absence elsewhere in the cited chapter or work. The Eichah Rabbah attribution and locator therefore remain Hyman’s report, and its abbreviated personal title remains R'. The supplied full Rav Huna heading is retained without harmonizing Huna and Chama.
